title: How Much Do Movers Cost in Addis Ababa? (2026 Pricing Guide)
excerpt: What drives moving prices in Addis Ababa: home size, floors and lifts, distance, packing, office IT, and long legs to Bishoftu or Sululta—plus how to get a written quote.
content:
Moving costs in Addis Ababa in 2026

There is no single price for every move. A studio in Jemo and a furnished office in Kazanchis are different jobs. Active Movers publishes starting prices on our local moving and office relocation pages; your final quote follows a quick assessment of access, volume, and timing.

What affects your quote

  • Volume and home type — studio vs multi-bedroom condo vs villa or compound.
  • Access — ground floor vs high-rise; service lift vs stair carry; distance from truck to door.
  • Distance — within one sub-city vs cross-town; extensions toward Bishoftu (~47 km) or Sululta often add travel and crew time.
  • Packing — full pack/unpack, fragile-only, or customer-packed.
  • Special items — safes, pianos, fine art, commercial kitchen or IT racks.
  • Timing — end-of-month demand, weekends, or after-hours office moves.

Apartment vs office vs villa

Apartment moves are the most common in Addis and are priced by bedrooms and access. Office moves add workstation count, cable labeling, and downtime windows. Villa and compound moves scale with room count, outdoor items, and multiple stops on the property.

Avoid surprise charges

Insist on a written quote after a site visit or detailed inventory. Ask what is included: crew size, truck type, disassembly, floor protection, and whether standby time from building delays is covered. Compare professional movers on contract clarity—not only the lowest phone estimate.

Active Movers starting points

Figures above are starting points for typical jobs in Addis Ababa; yours may be higher or lower. Book a free quote for a fixed plan before moving day.

How to read a quote

A fair Addis quote lists truck class, crew count, disassembly scope, blanket use, and whether stairs or shuttle trucks are included. If the number is far below these starts with no survey, assume missing line items—contract red flags · price creep.

Fixed vs hourly

Condos and cross-town jobs usually favor fixed pricing; small ground-floor loads may use capped hourly—hourly vs fixed guide. DIY comparisons belong in the true cost guide.

Save without scams

Declutter before survey, choose mid-week when lifts allow, and pair neighbors in the same tower—group move tips. End-of-month weekends cost more in time, not always in published tiers—rush guide.
